events.note: Created for typed MCP input constraints, schema compilation, and Studio type-reading consolidation.
Added typed constraint annotations, schema compilation, generic collection item schemas, Toonverse numeric bounds, and centralized Studio type resolution.
Refactored Hello World to expose every Studio object category as optional schema parameters and verified the generated schema.
Added and compiled companion constraints for every remaining Studio parameter object category, including explicit x-mcp extensions where JSON Schema has no standard keyword.
Applied a representative companion constraint to each optional Hello World parameter and expanded its schema regression test.
The next unresolved slice is to synchronize compiled input-schema constraints with Studio parameter controls and presentation; backend runtime validation remains a later follow-up.

The opt-in McpNumericSliderConstraints contract now publishes x-mcp-control: slider for bounded integer and decimal fields; Studio renders it as a snap-to-step slider with a bottom scale and editable right-side value setter.
The slider value setter now rests as a three-significant-digit mantissa plus external K/M-style unit, then expands to the exact value on hover or focus; its height and radius were reduced.
Expanded value width now derives from the complete raw decimal string plus two character cells, preventing dots, leading zeroes, signs, and fractional digits from clipping.
Defined a 16px range thumb and positioned minimum/midpoint/maximum labels beneath the matching thumb centers, eliminating endpoint offset.
